title: Private-model supply-chain security and architecture threat model
whatBuilt: Artifact-manifest control plane (stdlib-only): validated manifests binding kind/id/version/SHA-256 digest/producer/license/storageClass/lineage
HMAC-SHA256 signing over canonical JSON with constant-time verification; any manifest field change breaks the signature
Provenance-lineage verification: every parent must resolve to a registered artifact with the exact recorded digest (T5)
Registry read policy: consumers can never read private artifacts; owner/reviewer only (T4)

Repository exposure inventory (T3): path-pattern classification of credential material/templates/databases/model weights/datasets; credential-class contents NEVER read or recorded; streamed SHA-256 for weights/datasets; vendored-upstream scoping; oversized files recorded as skipped, never read
Structured THREAT_CATALOG T1-T7 mapped to implemented controls + THREAT_MODEL.md (assets, boundaries, controls, residual risks: key-rotation policy, public-history audit, registry backend)

evidenceFindings.notable: pinned ml/upstream reranker ONNX (flashrank-MiniLM-L-12-v2_Q.onnx, ~34MB) recorded with vendored-upstream scope + streamed digest; public git history NOT audited in this pass (follow-up recorded, not assumed clean)
